query_text: Somar, a Notary holding a licence to practise in the Judicial Zone of Colombo, is employed by a legal/real-estate company. Somar's employer instructs him to execute a Deed of Transfer of an urgent land transaction. Can Somar execute the deed without checking the title at the Land Registry? Explain with reference to the Notaries Ordinance.
